brief.zh: 每个角只输出一个点：Harris 响应乘 2 以后，峰顶输出 1。
brief.en: Output a single point per corner: after multiplying the Harris response by 2, output 1 at its tops.

hint.zh: 门槛只能留下一块一块，每个角留下好几格。
hint.en: A threshold leaves blobs: several cells per corner.

after.zh: 响应图一过门槛就是一片，片里只有峰顶是真正的角。先算响应、再找峰，是所有检测器的固定套路：角点、直线、物体框都这样。
after.en: Above a threshold the response is a patch, and only its top is the real corner. Response first, then peaks: every detector follows this routine, for corners, lines and object boxes alike.

t.zh: 托盘里的<part-ref to="own-6-2"></part-ref>在比 3×3 邻居都不小、又大于 0.3 的格子输出 1，其余输出 0。
t.en: The <part-ref to="own-6-2"></part-ref> in the tray outputs 1 where a cell is no smaller than its 3×3 neighbours and above 0.3, and 0 elsewhere.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：每个角只输出一个点。
t.en: Your task in this level: output a single point per corner.
